# A2UI conformance cases

These files are copied unchanged from the A2UI project,
[a2ui-project/a2ui](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui) at commit
`8bf644a37d680a227296b8c0849a7f4b328b8b73`, directory
`specification/v1_0/test/cases`. They are licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

`tests/a2ui-conformance.test.ts` runs the cases that apply to a renderer:
message shapes, dynamic values, function calls, checks and initial state.
Cases about upstream components that Sprout's catalog doesn't have, such as
icons and text variants, are left out.
